And in technology, like in machine learning, neural networks can develop complex decision-making abilities from simple layers of processing units.

But how can I connect these different examples into a coherent narrative? Maybe by highlighting the common thread of simplicity leading to complexity. Also, the idea that understanding the whole requires looking at the interactions rather than just the individual components
